value.rationale: The recently defined homology-polytopes are naturally parameterized by polygon triangulations. The theorem classifies their intrinsic Euclidean largest-ball radius and all centers through a concrete positive dual-tree resolvent, identifies a rigid two-contact phenomenon, and exhibits a nontrivial limiting factor between combinatorially identical but geometrically distinct infinite families. It is neither a face-number recomputation nor an arbitrary numerical slice; the embedding-sensitive metric is intrinsically motivated by the boundary representation.
